reviews.title: Horrible airline,AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!!
reviews.text: Flight was cancelled a couple of weeks before departure. Given option to switch to a different flight but would have missed my connection. Tried over the next 3 months to contact TAR for refund. Only way to try and reach them is by the phone number provided on their website ... which no one ever answers. Have tried multiple times over the course of different months, spent hours on hold, no one ever answers. No one replies to emails. Zero satisfaction. Took my money, cancelled the flight, should have been automatically refunded, spent months trying to have any communication with the company, zero response. This is no one way to run a company ... AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!!
reviews.author: goldengaterecordings

reviews.title: Still waiting for my refund 4.5 months after flight cancelled
reviews.text: Our flight was cancelled two weeks before our scheduled departure date. The booking agency says it's waiting for Tar to refund the money. That was 4.5 months ago. NOTHING. DO NOT FLY WITH THIS AIRLINE!
reviews.author: Jenny L

reviews.title: The last straw - never again
reviews.text: I fly PVR-AGU every month - but never again on TAR. Flights often delayed or cancelled. No info at airport gate on delays. No one picks up the phone. Staff can't change ticket at airport (no credit card machine). Can't change ticket or seats online. AEROMAR is a better option.
reviews.author: Steven S

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: Selected June 13th on website, date changed to June 15th without notification. On payment window there was no summary of date or cost, paid anyway only to see I had been charged an extra $100 of fees that were not present on the start page as well as found out that I bought tickets for a date that did not work for me because their website is terrible. Immediately got on the phone and after an hour of trying different lines, got a person on the phone. As soon as I described my problem they put me on hold without a word and did not pick back up. Tried pressing option 9 as a last resort which is supposed to be for cancellations related to covid and it simply ended the call.
reviews.author: Diego Katzakian

reviews.title: Do NOT book with TAR airlines.
reviews.text: Within 2 weeks of reserving round trip flights, both flights were cancelled by TAR. I was unable to get through on their contact line. I called many times and was on hold for 1 to 2 hours. They refuse to give my money back. They only offer a voucher that is good for 6 months, which I cannot use. This airline should not be in business.
reviews.author: Gail M

reviews.title: Company should be investigated
reviews.text: Seems to be a decent money making scheme. Sell flights, cancel them, don't give refunds. One other airline in Mexico does the same thing. How they are still getting away with it I'm not really sure. Frustrating because there is really nothing you can do about it. Trust the negative reviews.
reviews.author: Matt C

reviews.title: Don't believe the negative hype...
reviews.text: Hi all We recently flew TAR from GDL-PVR and could not be happier. The night before, I was very concerned as I read negative review after negative review and was worried our flight would be canceled and no refund issued, etc. However our experience could not have been more positive frankly. We got to GDL airport about 2.5 hours early. The gate agent showed up about 1hr. 50 mins before the flight. We promptly checked in, got our bag tag and boarding passes. The plane arrived at our gate about 15-20 mins. prior to departure. The plane was unloaded and we were boarded. I think there were about 5-10 people on the entire plane. If that. We took off about 5 minutes late. The flight attendant was friendly and very accomodating. She offered us water right after take off. I asked for a coke, then said water is fine. She came back shortly after and said they had Pepsi, not coke. I was fine with my water and politely declined. The flight was only about 30 minutes. As soon as we touched down and deplaned, our bag was waiting on the tarmac. We were out of the airport in less than 10 minutes on the way to our hotel. The moral of the story is that they did a good job from start to finish and I wasted time worrying about them based in thw reviews. Like the title says, don't believe the negative hype. They are a small airline, but at our experience was extremely positive.
reviews.author: Neil

reviews.title: HORRIBLE service and airline over ALL
reviews.text: I came one hour before my flight in Querétaro Mexico and they said I was “too late” to board the plane because apparently I needed to be here at least TWO hours in advanced. This is not an international flight, I was flying from Querétaro Mexico to Nuevo Vallarta Mexico. I have never been declined service being an hour early on a flight in the same country. Not to mention they wouldn’t even credit me for my “missed” flight to use on another flight. I unfortunately already had booked my flight back which I had to pay an additional $100 fee to “reactivate” and once I was at the airport the two hours early they said on my flight back NOBODY showed up till an hour before my flight. How are you going to make me miss my flight for not being here two hours early but when I am you don’t show up with the same expectation? They are a small airline and definitely are only looking for more ways to take your money. Never flying here again. Customer service was also no help at all. AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!
reviews.author: ana a

reviews.title: Refused to refund flight that they canceled
reviews.text: They refused to refund a flight that they themselves canceled. They offered a "coupon". Trash company.
reviews.author: Dany C

reviews.title: Worst Flight Company Ever
reviews.text: The experience starts with the airline asking us to be at the airport 2 hours before the flight yet they do not open the check in both until 1.5 hrs before the flight. The airline asked me to check some hand luggage as I am boarding and hand me a receipt. Once I land, I wait for my hand luggage and it doesn’t come out so I asked the people unloading where it was to which they respond to talk to the air line company. We go to their booth and there is no one there so we call and they do not pick up. After searching the airport and talking to people for 3 hrs. I find out the airline company only opens the booth when they have flights so if your flight lands and they do not have flights, you cannot reach them. They also do not pick up the phone unless you call in “certain hours”. The next day I manage to reach them on the phone and after wasting 2 hrs of my time, they say, there is nothing they can do since they are only a call center to book flights, even though that’s the only number on their website. The only thing they say is that I had to report my lost luggage in person at the airport but after spending another 3 hrs that morning looking and waiting for their booth or ticket counter to open, they did not. After failing to reach their “booth” to report my lost luggage, I had to take my next flight. After landing I call them again and they refused to connect me to their airport department. . We also tried to send emails to them and the only response we got was to call or go to the airport in person. The next day we have some local family go to the airport and try to make a report and even after talking to us on the phone, they refused to accept the report saying we had to appear in person even though we had already left. They also claimed we had messed up by not reporting this so the bag was too far lost but they weren’t even available or answering calls!!! Worst flight company ever. I would not recommend it It seems to me that asking us to check in a hand bag last minute was on a half empty flight was a scam to steal it, so be careful if you choose to fly with them. Plenty of other companies are available for the same price.
reviews.author: Ivan B

reviews.title: Thieves and Liars
reviews.text: Almost a year later and still no refund or voucher. Airlines cancelled me three times, said they could not refund the money but would send voucher, of course never happened. Contact them and a recording will send you to their e mail and hang up. Hope these crooks get a class action suit against them. If one is in effect, tell me, I want to join.
reviews.author: Richard O

reviews.title: Cancelled flight and no refund or credit
reviews.text: We had tickets purchased for this summer and TAR cancelled the flight and advised a credit would be forthcoming. We have heard nothing from the airline and their website does not work and it is impossible to get ahold of anyone on the phone . Essentially, TAR stole over $500 from us. Every other review that describes this airline as thieves, deceitful and ignorant is correct. Would never book this airline again and watch out that they do not defraud you as well!
reviews.author: Matthew B

reviews.title: The worst airline ever!!
reviews.text: I don’t usually like to talk bad about businesses, but this airline is the WORST that I have ever traveled in!! For starters the employees are very rude, they do not know how to communicate with the customer, they told me my flight was supposed to leave at a certain time when in reality it was leaving two hours before that. I would 100% not recommend this airline. Do not waste your money with them because they don’t care about their customers!! Normalmente no me gusta hablar mal de negocios, ¡pero esta aerolínea es la PEOR en la que he viajado! Para empezar los empleados son muy groseros, no saben cómo comunicarse con el cliente, me dijeron que se suponía que mi vuelo salía a una hora determinada cuando en realidad salía dos horas antes. No recomendaría al 100% esta aerolínea. ¡No desperdicie su dinero con ellos porque no se preocupan por sus clientes!
reviews.author: Thalia O

reviews.title: Avoid using this airline
reviews.text: So I buy my girlfriend a ticket for sunday june 28th and then they cancel flights for that day which starts a chain reaction of things that mess up our plans and cost us money and they say not their fault so I guess its my fault for choosing them. They are no good. They only have 11 planes so you are likely going to have problems and they wont do anything for you
reviews.author: Dan D

reviews.title: I sang their praises after years of flying with them, not anymore
reviews.text: After years of flying with Tar and accepting their lackluster service but applauding them for keeping prices low (you get what you pay for, I accept that), I recently got screwed by them in a big way. They kept cancelling or rescheduling my flight due to Covid 19, again, I understand and appreciate. Problem is that I purchased a ticked at 40% reduction, they changed my flights, not me. After the second cancellation, I rescheduled, but because I live an hour and half away from the airport I had to cancel the day before because they could not guarantee the flight was leaving. They then charged me for a reschedule and only credit, no refunds. Hope they go out of business. Crooks and liars.
reviews.author: Richard O

reviews.title: High and Dry
reviews.text: Sunday, Mar 8,2020. Flight 401, departs 2010hrs.But at 1530 hrs get an email from airline advising flight is cancelled. 5 hours before the flight. Already checked out of hotel. Already reserved a room at destination city. Six hours on phone to ask for compensation. No decision made. Form to fill out; wait 7-21 days. Unbelievable! Use this airline if you must but be aware they do not guarantee their flights. Kind of like rolling the dice to see if you fly. It’s your money. My choice will be NOT to use them again.
reviews.author: Bob F

reviews.title: Scary Company
reviews.text: Had a prepaid Mar 8 flight out of Huatulco at 8:10pm.At 3pm am notified the flight is cancelled. Toast. Already checked out of hotel, already booked hotel in destination city.Spent hours(6)on the phone trying to get compensated. That is still up in the air. Lesson here? Do not travel with TAR Airlines. You can roll the dice if you want but this airline does not guarantee their flights.
reviews.author: Bob F

reviews.title: Save yourself from a lot of problems. DON'T FLY TAR!
reviews.text: I had read review after review of of how horrible this airline and gave them the benefit of the doubt. We were to fly one hour from Guadalajara to Queretaro and our flight was cancelled. We ended up driving 4 hours to get to our destination and paying about $500 USD for additional car rental fees. I was told in order for me to get a refund I needed to turn in a form within 72 hours or the ticket would be closed and I would be in other words screwed. They wont refund your credit card and want all of your bank information in order to process the refund. Absolutely insane! Please save your self some troubles and find another worthy airline. I decided to give them the benefit of the doubt...I ask that you dont do the same mistake as I did. Dont fly with TAR airlines.
reviews.author: R.C

reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: If you are from the states, this is the equivalent of Spirit (of which I only flew once and then never again, much like TAR). My flight. was delayed several hours...when I called customer service, I stayed on the phone waiting for an agent for over. 30. minutes. Twice...I was never. connected. When I arrived at the airport for the delayed flight, there was no one at the check in counter. I waited 30 minutes for someone to arrive. Then I went through security. When my flight should have been boarding, I saw the gate had changed. It was on every screen in the airport so I went to the new gate. They had no idea what flight I was even talking about and told me to go to the one that was on my boarding pass, which I did. Again they did not know what I was talking about. The flight changed gates twice more, the original 4:15 flight did not take off until after 11:45 pm at night. They called it a flight change, then put two separate flights together, then had to redo. all the paperwork, and only 8 people on the whole plane. They would not. refund my money, and I would. have had to buy a whole new ticket to go on another flight at an earlier time. This was the worst service! Do not fly on this cheap airline unless you want to risk losing half a day in your destination and a good chance the flight would just be cancelled anyway. Then, to put salt in the wound, they wouldn't give any food/$ after a 7 our delay, but just said, if you call tomorrow we will give you a 25% off a future flight coupon...like I would ever fly this airline again.
reviews.author: wheretogonext1

reviews.title: Fly again
reviews.text: Flew into Durango for a quick 4 day trip and as usual this flight was on time and flight staff were attentive. The airport were also very friendly and helpful. The snacks were good and refreshments including Mezcal and Tequila were offered.
reviews.author: Luis S

reviews.title: WORST AIRLINE YOU MAY FIND. THIEVES
reviews.text: Tar aerolineas is one of the worst you may find. they cancelled flights, and if you are a foreigner and paid by credit card they do not return any money, demand a bank account number through internet in a very unsafe way and never send any money, nobody cares, you speak with stoneheads at the phone, they do not care about their breach of contract. Never use tar airline.Flights after flight are cancelled and they take no responsability. Tar aerolineas es pesima . Vuelos cancelados, sin importarles nada, y si eres extranjero y pagas , como todos con tarjeta de credito no te devuelven tu dinero, te lo roban. Te exigen una cuenta de cheques a la que nunca te lo abonan. Nadie se hace responsable. No toman responsabilidad de sus incumplimientos. Cancelan vuelo tras vuelo y no toman ninguna responsabilidad.
reviews.author: seasonedvisitor

reviews.title: DO NOT FLY WITH TAR!!!
reviews.text: We had 3 separate flights booked with this airline and all were cancelled. What's worse is due to having paid for the flights on credit card the company advised they would not refund the cost of the flight. Terrible customer service and no thought of customer impacts to internal processes. DO NOT FLY WITH TAR!!
reviews.author: Stuart E

reviews.title: terrible customer service
reviews.text: extremely frustrating booking a flight, you cannot buy a minor ticket online, I called 9 times to try to add my son to my existing itinerary, the 1st 6 times according to them all my 6 different credit cards declined ( had to call them back every time the card declined) when I called my bank they stated there were no attempts from TAR. and they kept telling me the declines were at my end :( decided to wait for the following day hoping their systems would work now. well this time I could not even get to the decline part as the 3 different agents I spoke to hung up on me once I got to the payment part they would not come back. after the 11th attempt I was finally able to speak to a rep by the name of Jonathan T was able to get help and options.
reviews.author: Sandy

reviews.title: Run away for this airline!
reviews.text: Do NOT give this airline your business. Some flights were booked for us and sure enough (as they have done previously) TAR arbitrarily cancelled the flights due to "operational reasons." TAR has no problem taking payment from your credit card but they refuse to refund $ back to your credit card in the event of a flight cancellation. And good luck trying to get your money back: hours on the phone with customer service, forms to fill out, and they will only wire the refunded money back to your bank account (vs. simply crediting your credit card). Then they create add'l delays & problems regarding SWIFT vs IBAN #s. All of this hassle seems geared toward ripping off customers and frustrating them to the point where they just give up on getting their refund back. Insidious business practices. How are they still in business???
reviews.author: Kyra B

reviews.title: TWICE FLIGHT CANCELLED...NO REFUND
reviews.text: Two times TAR has delayed, then canceled a flight from GDL-PVR which we were informed of in a taxi on the way to the airport. When we arrived, we were told we need to call a phone number to apply for the refund...the check-in desk at the airport could not help us. Fine. Except I spent the next 2 hours trying to talk to a human and getting hung up on. By then they had produced a new flight (after we spent hundreds of dollars to return on another airline) and were trying to tell us at the desk that the flight was not cancelled, but changed. If we did not get in touch by phone, we would not get a refund. UGH! The next day I called and got through, explained the whole issue and received a code and another email address to request the refund. I wrote the email and received a reply today., a month later! We will be receiving 25% of the cost of our ticket! And we still have to apply! HORRIBLE AIRLINE. WHAT A SCAM!!!!! TWICE BURNED, NEVER AGAIN!
reviews.author: Maracuya Fashion Boutique

reviews.title: Horrible experience
reviews.text: Flight was supposed to leave at 1:10pm.@ 9am I get an email saying my flight was delayed (departure time 3:15) Since I was already heading to airport I figured I could wait and grab a bite. As I am eating I received an email saying my flight was cancelled. I go back to the check in area. The (NOT SO NICE) ladies tell me no flights have been cancelled. I showed them the email and they said it was just a delayed.so they gave me a new ticket. Unfortunatelly, I lost my ticket. I decided to call TAR and after a 25 minute wait they answer and suddenly call drops. I called again and 30 minutes later they answered just to tell me they cant email my ticket that I need to go to the airport booth or I wont be allowed in the plane. (here I go out of aiport again) This time I got my ticket and guess what? (different time!!! Now 5:15pm ) By 5:30pm we went out of airport again and told the ladies that we had been waiting for longer that 4 hours. Their answer was you did a flight change to 3:15 so the system shows you been waiting for only about 2 hours) Well, I didn't change nothing, you guys did it after you cancelled my first flight 😡. After wasting so much of my time, I ended up departing at 6:30pm. If you want to save time and headaches dont fly here. NOT RELIABLE!!!! It takes from 20 to 30 minutes for them to answer you phone calls and they wont solve your issue.
reviews.author: Jay

reviews.title: luxury tin can
reviews.text: Really small and cramped but worth every penny. Very few bells and whistles. We paid a small upgrade charge to sit in upper class, which basically gave us 5cm more leg room. I love this airline, does not try to be anything more than it is, reliable, on time, courteous. Very in expensive rates.
reviews.author: Richard O

reviews.title: TAR Aerolínea
reviews.text: I would definitely not recommend this Airline. First we had a 2 hour delay, then a 4 hour delay, and there excuse was that the airplane was at maintenance. I checked the other flights to Puerto Vallarta and "coincadently" they were at the same time as the delays were set. I'm sure it was because not enough people were flying. Waste of time and money.
reviews.author: Nancy Gomez

reviews.title: Worst airline ever
reviews.text: Paid for a ticket with a credit card weeks in advance. The payment was processed and cleared. Arrived at the airport to find out they claim the payment was declined. Had to pay for the ticket again. Now the airline is using the second ticked paid with cash to claim that I used the first booking. Refused to refund. Worst customer service ever. Read all other reviews and be ready to receive the worst service ever.
reviews.author: Oz O

reviews.title: Intra Mexico Flight
reviews.text: Everything was quick, efficient, and on time. One word of caution, their website in not very user friendly. You have to read, thoroughly and know what you want.
reviews.author: Ernie L

reviews.title: The Poor rating is for Customer Service. Other services were good.
reviews.text: My poor rating is for Customer Service. I needed to cancel a flight within the, allowed, 24 hours of booking. It was impossible to get a refund. I invested around 20 hours of phone calls to customer service, writing of emails and creating documentation (including my checking account information???). The only thing that worked in the end was a dispute through my Capital One credit card. Kudos to them. To be fair, other services were good, including the flight, small aircraft and personnel on the ground and in flight. ***Customer Service*** must be greatly improved and the refund process if they expect to grow their business.
reviews.author: Vacationer783304

reviews.title: Avoid this airline at all cost.
reviews.text: Find another airline!!! This one is a joke. 8 hours on the phone with different people just to rearrange a flight that they cancelled. Many people in Querétaro warned me not to use them. I wish i'd listened. It's not good when everyone in a small city is saying not to use the airline from that city.
reviews.author: Jontymot

reviews.title: Smooth Ride
reviews.text: It was an on-time departure and the flight was very smooth throughout the trip. The attendant was very attentive to the needs of all passengers. This flight only had 29 passengers and carries up to 50. There were no delays anywhere and all staff were very helpful.
reviews.author: Luis S

reviews.title: A regional Mexican airline that puts large American carriers to shame.
reviews.text: I have flown TAR on four separate flights, between Puerto Valllarta and either Queretaro or Leon/Baijo. On each occasion, my flight experience was excellent. The flights left and arrived on time. The service personel, both at the check-in counter and on the aircraft, were courteous, helpful, and efficient. The commuter-sized aircraft was clean and comfortable. I find this fine Mexican airline to offer a much more hassle-free experience than almost any U. S. airline (with the notable exception of the famously customer-friendly Southwest Airlines). TAR is an impressive credit to Mexico.
reviews.author: James Kurth

reviews.title: Stay away from this “airline “
reviews.text: If you have an other way to get to your destination do not think about it twice. Even if it is more expensive do it. Stay away from this terrible company.
reviews.author: Alejandro M

reviews.title: Regional airline company with very good service
reviews.text: Service it is good, they have regional planes and they give snacks, I mean is not cheap airline but in the Northwest of Mexico there is no many options to fly between cities arround 1 Million
reviews.author: franciscocH457OG

reviews.title: Oaxaca, Huatulco
reviews.text: I took the round trip from Oaxaca to Huatulco and the flight was just fine; the planes are small in seats number but the space is more than enough. It had maybe a 15 to 20 minute delay but the service is good.
reviews.author: Lilia F

reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: Small airplanes, but clean, excellent service, Airplanes in mint condition, and no cost drinks. I'm a fan.
reviews.author: Adan R

reviews.title: Price is right, service is good
reviews.text: TAR is a regional Mexico airline. Price is affordable. Schedule varies from good to late night economy. Planes are comfortable but not lux. I would fly them again
reviews.author: ctzgtomx

reviews.title: Very good Airlines
reviews.text: Very great staff. The girl and man behind the desk when we were checking in at Calafia Airlines heard that the staff at the ticket booth would not let our 2 pound pup fly under the seat with us in the aircraft. We had flown up on Calafia airlines from Puerta vallarta on Calafia airlines and they let our dog fly inder the seat with us in the cabin. So there was no difference, we were doing the same flight on the same airline, just returning to Puerta Vallarta. So TAR let us fly with them, and our pup got to go in the cabin under the seat. They were so nice and helpful,. without these great people at TAR we would have missed our flight back to Canada.
reviews.author: Brian D

reviews.title: Fantastic airfares
reviews.text: How great to have an option that doesn't go through Mexico City! Now I can fly all over Mexico without having to take a bus to Mexico City first. The fare are cheaper then flying on Aeromexico from Mexico City to Huatulco without the hassle! Go TAR Aerolineas! Bravo!
reviews.author: Zorroismycopilot

reviews.title: Nice flight
reviews.text: Our flight was on time, people friendly, nice waiting area with coffee and lunch nearby. Seats were small but so was the plane. Everything we needed was available. I would fly TAR again.
reviews.author: _smithnancya

reviews.title: Almost two hours late leaving, two and a half hours late on the return flight
reviews.text: I really will not complain too much since I still had a fabulous vacation. The in flight staff was excellent and helpful, am sure they hear a lot of complaints. Desk service sucked and they literally hid out during the whole delay, only emerging once the very late flight was ready. From a previous experience where they screwed me out of my flight, they gave me credit for future flights. The only way I could use the credit was to buy a first class ticket on a puddle jumper on this most recent flight. Really not a good airline, ashame because as I said, the in flight staff was triple A and five star. Flights are not cheap and very limited connection sites, which you can be assured, you will arrive late and have missed your next connection.
reviews.author: Richard O

reviews.title: Amazing experience, staff really went above and beyond
reviews.text: I flew TAR for the first time after my friend recommended it to me. I'm usually fairly indifferent about airlines and honestly hadn't heard much about this one. All this to say the service was phenomenal, the flight attendants are very attentive (and my I add very good looking too). I don't travel within Mexico often but I've told all my Mexican friends about this airline. Try it you won't regret it
reviews.author: Miles B

reviews.title: TAR flight Monterrey - Tampico 6/2018
reviews.text: first time i flew with TAR Aerolineas, was an Embraer 145, plane was fairly old, flight was full, service was ok and staff was friendly, arrived a little late, but still acceptable
reviews.author: blueskies15-10

reviews.title: SCAM!
reviews.text: This is another airline in Mexico practicing BAIT and SWITCH! You will have your flight CANCELED if you book with them. Then, you'll waste hours trying to get the refund that they promise but NEVER deliver on. YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED! STAY AWAY!
reviews.author: WanderingMinstral9

reviews.title: Young airline, small planes, great service
reviews.text: We experimented great service from the clerks. Aircraft is small, but on a short flight, it's good. We hope to see this airline grow and expand.
reviews.author: Mauricio A

reviews.title: Worst customer service from an airline
reviews.text: Be very careful with this airline Yesterday for the very first time in my life I was not able to check in my luggage. I was not given any reason for this. They said, it will be sent “eventually” to your destination. One day after my flight, I have called both Tar terminals, my departure and arrival destinations, nobody at the airline can provide feedback about te luggage status. I called TAR main call center, they have no idea about how to help. TAR customer service is beyond pathetic. It is a shame, they have good routes, prices and the concept is awesome, however with the lack of customer service I don’t see how these guys will stay in business. If you decide to fly with TAR, don’t take your chances and go Carry on.
reviews.author: orangecountycarlos

reviews.title: Very good value for the Money!
reviews.text: The flight was on time. Customer Service on the ground (check in) and in the plane was very friendly, and make people feel welcomed. For short flights will definitely fly with them again!
reviews.author: OscarReneML

reviews.title: TAR is terrible!
reviews.text: HORRIBLE. AVOID at all cost. Not worth it, flights always delayed or cancelled for reasons that are clearly lies. Their phone customer service is incompetent & you can’t change flights via their (crummy) website & their phone customer service lies to you. Terrible.
reviews.author: Kyra B
